media_work.focus_or_theme: In-depth reinvestigation of Darlie Routier case, new evidence/forensic analysis

media_item.focus_or_theme: In-depth reinvestigation of Darlie Routier case, new evidence/forensic analysis
media_item.summary_notes: A multi-hour special examining new evidence and forensic analysis in the Darlie Routier case. Ongoing, court-ordered DNA testing on key pieces of evidence, the results of which are still pending.

research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Multi-hour special examining new evidence and forensic analysis in Routier case; more detailed than previous coverage. Available via NBC/Peacock.
research_notes_other.research_findings: While a specific Dateline episode with this exact title wasn't confirmed, the description points to a deeper investigation into the Routier case. The most significant update is the ongoing, court-ordered DNA testing on key pieces of evidence, the results of which are still pending after several years. A 2015 book, "Dateline Purgatory," also examined the case controversies.

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Convicted of capital murder in 1997 and sentenced to death. The case focuses on the re-analysis of disputed forensic evidence, with results of court-ordered DNA testing still pending as of 2024.
contributing_factors_raw: Focus on re-analysis of disputed forensic evidence (blood spatter, fingerprint, sock)
organizations_involved_raw: Legal teams pursuing appeals and DNA testing
